text:
This matter has been reviewed by the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

We understand your concern regarding the handling of Nala during transit, and you reported that communication and support did not reflect the care you expected when the situation arose.

For escape in transit, you must submit your claim within 59 days, and we recommend doing so promptly to help our team collect the right records. Once a claim is filed, the welcome team and the station partners review the boarding preparation notes, scan events, and any handling logs available for the affected route. The senior coordinator follows up with the right parties to confirm what occurred and when, and the goal is to keep the process straightforward and respectful from first contact through resolution.

Regarding your specific report, we will also document the timeline of your interactions with our staff and ensure that your feedback is routed to the appropriate operational supervisor. When a traveler is worried, we expect prompt, calm communication and clear next steps, and we take seriously any instance where those standards were not met. If you already submitted paperwork, our records aide will match it to the shipment and any companion-care documentation associated with your booking, and we will confirm the status without delay.

If you have not yet provided supporting materials, such as incident details, confirmation references, or any relevant communications, include them in your claim packet so the team can proceed efficiently. Travel guidance is meant to be concise, kind, and actionable, and we will use your experience to strengthen how our agents respond in the moments that matter.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we will work to restore confidence in how we support companion animals and their travelers.
